chapter.title: The Original Arrival
chapter.subtitle: Fix the moment. Choose the road.
chapter.description: Anunaki Arrival · Chapter 8. Fix the moment. Choose the road.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Anu
scenes.text: Our ships descend while your breach draws them off course. Archive, gate, conduit: each must hold.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: Three districts. Same fight, much bigger security deposit.

scenes.speaker: Yasuke
scenes.text: We know the sequence. We know who is beside us. Begin.

tips: Prepare Tablets before the pressure increases. Holding two districts wins; stars are optional.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: Prepare Tablets before the pressure increases. Holding two districts wins; stars are optional.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Utu
preDialogue.text: First wave approaching. Keep the archive clear.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: Nobody parks a spaceship on my paperwork.

postDialogue.speaker: Utu
postDialogue.text: The archive stands. Next wave crosses the gate.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Anu gets one announced round-4 reinforcement. Bank power in a second district before it arrives.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Gate Pressure
passive.description: Anu gets one announced round-4 reinforcement. Bank power in a second district before it arrives.

phases.name: Gate Pressure
phases.description: At round 4, Nabu joins the enemy hand once. Prepare another district before the pressure arrives.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Anu
preDialogue.text: The gate demands strength in reserve. Do not spend everything on the first opening.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: A victory that cannot endure is only a pause.

postDialogue.speaker: Anu
postDialogue.text: The gate holds. Now withstand the conduit.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: That was the affordable part, apparently.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Complete the chapter to advance. Optional stars never block the next chapter.

scenes.speaker: Nabu
scenes.text: The record is complete. Read each clue before moving the pieces. A correct sequence is safer than a quick guess.

puzzle.title: The Final Return
puzzle.instruction: Order the safe departure. Fix direction before entering the year. Enter the year before verifying the gate. Launch only after verification.

pieces.label: Verify gate
pieces.detail: Confirm archive, gate and conduit are synchronized.

pieces.label: Launch together
pieces.detail: The final step follows the all-clear.

hints: Correct the direction before setting the destination.
puzzle.solvedText: FORWARD. The right year. A stable gate. For the first time, every part of the machine agrees about where home is.
puzzle.skipText: Your crew works through the clues with you. You continue with the same story progress and rewards.

tips: The center closes in round 3. Use the outside districts to preserve a route through the surge.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Ancient Field
passive.description: The center closes in round 3. Use the outside districts to preserve a route through the surge.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Enlil
preDialogue.text: Conduit surging. Close the center and keep the outside anchors alive.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: I would like to unsubscribe from the sky.

postDialogue.speaker: Ninhursag
postDialogue.text: Both anchors remain. The core can take the final pulse.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

tips: Spend one Tablet to discount your temporary Anu; consume the remaining Tablets only when their power wins the gate.
Any temporary ally is for this encounter only. Collectible unlocks come from the journey or featured banner.

passive.name: Gate Pressure
passive.description: Spend one Tablet to discount your temporary Anu; consume the remaining Tablets only when their power wins the gate.

phases.name: Gate Pressure
phases.description: At round 4, Nabu joins the enemy hand once. Prepare another district before the pressure arrives.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

preDialogue.speaker: Anu
preDialogue.text: One final charge. Hold two districts and the breach closes behind your machine.

preDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
preDialogue.text: We will leave no one under it.

preDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
preDialogue.text: Correct year. Correct direction. Hands up.

postDialogue.speaker: Anu
postDialogue.text: The descent is restored. Your road is yours to choose.

postDialogue.speaker: Yasuke
postDialogue.text: Then today, I return with the people who stood beside me.

postDialogue.speaker: Captain Jigga
postDialogue.text: And tomorrow we read the entire receipt.

starObjectives.description: Finish holding at least two districts.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: There they go. Two satisfied customers.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: We repaired your machine, survived the first arrival, and nearly got billed by the underworld.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: So you are saying it travels through time.

scenes.speaker: Cracked Head
scenes.text: Warranty? This was the demo unit.

scenes.speaker: Captain Jigga
scenes.text: I am walking. I am just walking angrily.
